partially_covered.missing: Organization information is limited to name and address; no additional fields (e.g., contact info, registration number, tax ID) have been added.
No explicit OWL cardinality or value constraints to enforce mandatory fields for file format validity; only implicit via domains/ranges.

cq_coverage.details: The ontology continues to structurally answer most CQs, but CQ5 (organization details) and CQ13 (validation requirements) remain only partially addressed due to lack of new properties and constraints.

strengths: Rich class hierarchy with pivot classes for n-ary relations
Consistent use of labels and comments
Appropriate use of functional properties and disjointness
weaknesses: No GCAs or equivalence axioms for complex definitions
Minimal use of advanced OWL constructs (e.g., no cardinality restrictions)
Limited disjointness (not all relevant class pairs are disjoint)

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4 (Missing domain or range for some properties, e.g., some inverses may lack explicit annotation)
P7 (Missing inverse properties for some relations, but most are covered)

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand the 'Organization' class with additional properties (e.g., contact info, registration number, tax ID) to better address CQ5.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves completeness for queries about organization information.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add explicit OWL cardinality or value constraints (e.g., min/max cardinality, required properties) or SHACL shapes to define what information is mandatory for file format validity (CQ13).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables validation of message completeness and format compliance.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) or owl:equivalentClass definitions for key classes (e.g., define 'BuyerRole' as a restriction on Role).
Add cardinality restrictions (e.g., each Invoice must have at least one buyer and one seller involvement).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Strengthens data integrity and query reliability.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Broaden disjointness axioms to cover more class pairs (e.g., Address vs. Invoice, Item vs. BusinessProcess).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Reduces risk of unintended class overlap.
